name: Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench (LHTB)
summary: Sustain useful work in a containerised terminal over hundreds of steps on scientific and engineering tasks, including reconstructing tools from outputs.

reward.note: Hidden rebuild-from-artifact verifiers grade the result; soft solves count at reward 0.95 or above, and the agent is rejected with a binary signal until timeout or pass.

needs: Docker; modified Harbor from the GitHub repo to reproduce official numbers

name: MiMo V2.6 RL OSS Japanese prompt derivative
summary: Japanese machine-translated prompts from MiMo-V2.6-RL-oss covering code, cyber, general, webdev and music tasks, plus the upstream general task bundle.

reward.note: The card says the upstream general task bundle includes verifiers but gives no reward details for this derivative.

needs: Container images and external grading services from the upstream source

name: Finance-ops spreadsheet agent training environment
summary: Given an input.xlsx workbook and a plain-English request, add the requested result sheets to the same workbook for finance operations work.

name: Text-to-CAD and drawing-to-CAD training environment
summary: Produce one exact solid as a STEP file (or watertight STL) in CadQuery from a text or drawing specification.

reward.note: A hidden parametric reference and a geometric grader decide pass or fail.

name: Playbook, the verifiable deal gym
summary: Handle a legal matter file: ask limited client questions, flag issues, propose redlines, escalate, negotiate with a scripted counterparty and submit a summary.

reward.note: Deterministic verifiers score against expert-authored rubrics with no LLM judge; critical failures cap the normalised score at 0.25.

run:
playbook-bench --runner baseline --model <model> --base-url <url> \
  --seeds 0 1 2 --family-registry datasets/matter-families.yaml --save-traces
needs: Code and engine live on GitHub, not in this repository
validated: Replay determinism: every episode trace re-scores identically against the matter package.

name: VoiceEnv: Money Transfer
summary: Act as a voice agent handling a money-transfer call, extracted from one real human-human call recording, and respond turn by turn to the caller audio.

reward.note: Turn-level evaluation with a verifiable rubric, judged by Gemini grounded on the real human recording.

run:
from voiceenv.core.schema import VoiceEnvironment
env = VoiceEnvironment.from_yaml("env.yaml")
needs: API access for audio models and judge
validated: An env-driven prompt improvement loop reportedly gave +0.50 average score.

name: AstroAgentBench
summary: Solve space mission design problems such as satellite scheduling and regional coverage, delivering outputs checked by an independent verifier.

reward.note: Each task has an independent verifier with benchmark-specific native scores; scores must not be combined across families.

run: harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/kaupane/AstroAgentBench@v2.0.0 --dataset smoke@v2.0.0 --agent oracle -n 1 --jobs-dir results --job-name astroagentbench-smoke
needs: Docker, Harbor 0.23.0, Python 3.13; 8 CPUs and 16 GiB per task by default
validated: Seven oracle reference checks, one per benchmark family, form the smoke set.

name: BARC-Bench (SafetyBench AgentEnv)
summary: Complete ordinary workplace requests across email, Slack, calendars and documents while respecting limits on disclosure, authorisation and record preservation.

reward.note: The safetybench_outcome_v2 verifier checks captured state, artifacts and action history against a rubric: 1 safe, 0 unsafe, null unscored.

run:
python run_benchmark.py --task sb_001_juniper --execute \
  --agent-image "$SOLVER_IMAGE" --model "$MODEL" \
  --api-base "$MODEL_BASE_URL" --api-key-env SAFETYBENCH_MODEL_KEY \
  --judge-model "$JUDGE_MODEL" --judge-api-base "$JUDGE_BASE_URL" \
  --judge-api-key-env SAFETYBENCH_JUDGE_KEY
needs: Linux, Docker, Python 3.12+, an A2A solver image and a judge model key
validated: The verifier is experimental; 8 of 15 pilot attempts were scored and matched prior labels.

name: Arena Domain Lab v21: Cybersecurity Audit Trail
summary: Read a compact security log, apply a stated rule, write one JSON artefact and submit it to a deterministic grader.

reward.note: A deterministic grader scores the submitted JSON artefact; exact-solve outcomes are used for calibration.

needs: Docker image kshitij190/arena-domain-lab:cybersecurity-v21
validated: 41 of 50 tasks gave mixed exact-solve outcomes over eight Qwen3.8-27B Q4 rollouts each; OpenEnv validation passed.

name: SWE-Lego RL 2699
summary: Fix real Python repository issues from OpenSWE, edited in a sandbox and graded by hidden tests.

reward.note: tests/test.sh applies the oracle test patch after the agent finishes and turns the test exit code into a 0 or 1 reward.

run:
python utils/prepare_repos.py \
    --harbor-root ./openswe_harbor_2699/task_instances \
    --jsonl ./openswe_official_2699/openswe_source_2699.jsonl \
    --workers 8
needs: Docker; about 100 GB of restored source checkouts
validated: Tasks were kept because a policy solved them in roughly 1 to 3 of 4 rollouts; gold patches support oracle checks.

name: Lego-RL SWE-Bench Verified
summary: Resolve the 500 SWE-bench Verified issues in Harbor task directories, graded by the official FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS tests.

reward.note: test.sh applies the upstream test patch and the official swebench parser checks FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS, writing a 0 or 1 reward.

needs: Docker with the official swebench images
validated: Instance set verified identical to princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Verified; gold patch expected to give reward 1.0.

run:
uv run harbor run -p harbor/airline-task_58d9d004df44 -a oracle
uv run harbor run -p harbor/airline-task_58d9d004df44 -a <agent> -m <provider/model>
needs: Judge model API key for judge items
validated: All 130 tasks replay as recorded, but the card warns some verifiers may check the wrong thing.

name: retail (Kullback)
summary: Handle retail customer requests such as order queries with tools over a simulated world, rebuilt from recorded tau2-bench traces.

reward.note: A code verifier checks the end state; reward.txt is 1 only when every gated item holds, and weighted items shape a separate shaped_reward. A judge model scores some items.

run:
uv run harbor run -p harbor/retail-task_1c8acd15f1fb -a oracle
uv run harbor run -p harbor/retail-task_1c8acd15f1fb -a <agent> -m <provider/model>

name: Travel Agency
summary: Act as TripDesk customer support on a broken trip from a real complaint, using tools on a live database and graded on what the agent changed.

reward.note: A run passes only if the end database state, per-write policy rules, key reply facts and no-false-claims checks all hold; reply checks use a judge.

run:
harbor run -p travel-agency -a nop -n 4
export KULLBACK_JUDGE_MODEL=anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
harbor run -p travel-agency -a oracle -n 4
harbor run -p travel-agency -a claude-code -m anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 -n 4
needs: Docker, Harbor and a judge model key for a full score
validated: The no-op agent scores 0.0 on every task and the oracle should score 1.0 with a judge.

name: openai/math as Harbor environments

reward.note: Comparator checks the exact original statement, only standard axioms and kernel acceptance; reward 1 if so, 0 otherwise.

reward.note: A deterministic verifier judges each step against a frozen reaction library, with a similarity bonus for known routes.

validated: Every task ships a witness route proving it is solvable under its constraint.

name: RetroEnv-Curated
summary: Plan multistep retrosynthesis routes for a target molecule with tools, submitting synthesis trees whose leaves are all in a frozen stock.

reward.note: A deterministic verifier judges each step against the reaction library, never against a hidden answer.

hf download LiteFold/RetroEnv-Curated --repo-type dataset --local-dir RetroEnv-Curated
RETROENV_BENCHMARK_DIR=RetroEnv-Curated uv run uvicorn retroenv_openenv.server:app --port 8000

name: ExtractBench
summary: Extract schema-valid JSON from a full PDF document, with correct exhaustive values, nulls for absent data, and a page and bounding box as evidence.

reward.note: Unified value F1 against expected output, plus word-level and page-level grounding F1 on documents with verified box ground truth.

run:
uv run extract-bench download          # data/<split>/<doc>.pdf + <doc>.test.json
uv run extract-bench run <pipeline>    # inference -> evaluation -> reports

name: ExtractBench Pro
summary: Extract schema-valid JSON from hard synthetic PDFs where values must be read from charts, counted under document rules or decoded with custom terminology.

reward.note: Unified value F1 on every document, with grounding F1 on the 81 documents that have box ground truth; expected outputs are exact by construction.

run:
uv run extract-bench download --dataset pro                    # data-pro/<split>/<doc>.pdf + <doc>.test.json
uv run extract-bench run llamaextract_agentic --dataset pro    # inference -> evaluation -> reports

name: ProgAgent Environments
summary: Solve tool-use tasks across 215 task families, each at four scales, by calling environment tools or writing programs that call them.

reward.note: The task's Task_Env.verify() records the reward; the oracle writes reference deliverables using it.

harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/LLLeo612/ProgAgent-Environments \
  --dataset standard-v0@1.0.0 \
  --include-task-name '*ad-inventory-pricing-optimization-v0' \
  --agent oracle --env docker --jobs-dir results/oracle

name: Maydan HF RL Sampler

run: python3 scripts/run_reference_and_tests.py

validated: Oracle reached reward 1.0 on all ten tasks with Harbor 0.24.0; negative tests were run.

name: LH-Bench: Credit Underwriting (preview)
summary: Extract structured transactions from 1 to 73 bank statement PDFs per business and categorise each by type and counterparty for credit risk assessment.

reward.note: Fully programmatic grading using hash-based extraction F1 and categorisation accuracy against expert-labelled ground truth.

reward.note: Each family ships tests and reference solutions kept outside the solver workspace; the card gives no scoring formula.

  --families html-finance-verify --replicates 1
